name: PostHog
tagline: Product analytics API with events, feature flags, and session data
description: PostHog is a product analytics platform offering REST APIs for querying events, managing feature flags, persons, insights, and project data. Hosted Cloud (US/EU) and self-hosted deployments are supported; capture and query endpoints enable analytics automation and integrations.

auth.details: Personal API key via Authorization: Bearer header for private endpoints; project API key for public capture endpoints. Self-serve signup.
